answers.sql:
SELECT
  ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
  COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON f.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT d_jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
       COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON f.JUR_K = d_jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT
  br.BUS_ID AS branch_id,
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN target_date d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT d.CMPLT_CTG_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM AS category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY d.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
WHERE DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE DT_DT = '2023-08-31');

SELECT
  CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(BUS_DT_K::text, 'YYYYMMDD')) AS year,
  AVG(AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE(BUS_DT_K::text, 'YYYYMMDD')) = 2025
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

WITH vals AS (
  SELECT
    d.MKT_K,
    d.DSPLY_NM AS market_name,
    SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
  FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON f.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT d ON f.MKT_K = d.MKT_K
  WHERE ddt.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY d.MKT_K, d.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT * FROM vals ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
  b.CTY_NM AS city,
  COUNT(*) AS atm_transactions
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY b.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transactions DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH disputes AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR,
         COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT MTH_NBR, dispute_count
FROM disputes
ORDER BY MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment_code;

WITH txns_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.DT_D) = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM txns_2025 t WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K);

WITH alerts AS (
  SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
         COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts
  FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a

  GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT jurisdiction_name, high_severity_alerts
FROM alerts;

answers.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH txn_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND b.IS_CURR = TRUE
  GROUP BY b.RGN_CD1, b.DSPLY_NM
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_txn_cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn_counts
)
SELECT region_code, branch_name, atm_txn_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

WITH auth_2025 AS (
  SELECT d.MRCH_CTG_CD1,
         SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH d ON f.MRCH_K = d.MRCH_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.DT_DT) = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MRCH_CTG_CD1
)
SELECT MRCH_CTG_CD1, total_amount
FROM auth_2025
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT
    c.BUS_ID,
    SUM(t.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.DT_K BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20251231
  GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
)
SELECT BUS_ID, total_amount
FROM transfers
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH dt AS (
  SELECT DT_K, CAL_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAL_DT) = 2025
)
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

WITH wire AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers_with_both
FROM wire w
JOIN atm a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH recent_interactions AS (
  SELECT
    ci.CUST_K,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ci.INTRC_TYP_CD1 = 'COMPLAINT') AS complaint_cnt,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ci.INTRC_TYP_CD1 = 'NEGATIVE') AS negative_cnt,
    COUNT(*) AS total_cnt,
    MAX(ci.CNTCT_STRTD_AT) AS last_interaction
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CUST_INTRC ci
  WHERE ci.CNTCT_STRTD_AT >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days')
  GROUP BY ci.CUST_K
), churn_risk AS (
  SELECT
    r.CUST_K,
    r.complaint_cnt,
    r.negative_cnt,
    r.total_cnt,
    r.last_interaction,
    -- simple heuristic score
    (r.complaint_cnt * 3 + r.negative_cnt * 2 + r.total_cnt) AS risk_score
  FROM recent_interactions r
)
SELECT
  c.CUST_K,
  c.BUS_ID,
  c.DSPLY_NM,
  cr.risk_score,
  cr.complaint_cnt,
  cr.negative_cnt,
  cr.total_cnt,
  cr.last_interaction
FROM churn_risk cr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON cr.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
ORDER BY cr.risk_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH wr AS (
  SELECT d.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
         f.STLM_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.DT_YR = 2025
)
SELECT currency,
       SUM(STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM wr
GROUP BY currency
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

SELECT
  ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
  COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON f.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT d_jur.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
       COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR d_jur ON f.JUR_K = d_jur.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d_dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY d_jur.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

WITH txn AS (
  SELECT d_br.BR_K, d_br.DSPLY_NM, d_dt.DT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
  WHERE d_dt.DT BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT BR_K, DSPLY_NM, COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM txn
GROUP BY BR_K, DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.DT_D) = 2025;

WITH last_day AS (
  SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dflt.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dflt
JOIN last_day ld ON dflt.BUS_DT_K = ld.DT_K
WHERE dflt.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT d.CMPLT_CTG_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM AS category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY d.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

WITH august_last AS (
  SELECT DT_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2023-08-31'  -- adjust year as needed
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dlt.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlt
JOIN august_last a ON dlt.BUS_DT_K = a.DT_K
WHERE dlt.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    CCY_CD1 AS currency,
    BUS_DT_K::DATE AS business_date,
    AVRG_RT AS avg_rate
  FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM BUS_DT_K::DATE) = 2025
)
SELECT
  currency,
  AVG(avg_rate) AS average_daily_fx_rate
FROM daily
GROUP BY currency
ORDER BY currency;

WITH vals AS (
  SELECT
    m.DSPLY_NM AS market_name,
    d.CAL_DT,
    SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS market_value
  FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
  GROUP BY m.DSPLY_NM, d.CAL_DT
)
SELECT market_name, CAL_DT, market_value
FROM vals
ORDER BY market_name, CAL_DT;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
  b.CTY_NM AS city,
  COUNT(*) AS atm_transactions
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
GROUP BY b.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transactions DESC;

SELECT AVG(CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D
WHERE CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND DATE_TRUNC('month', TO_DATE(BUS_DT_K::text, 'YYYYMMDD')) = DATE '2025-12-01';

WITH disputes AS (
  SELECT d.MTH_NBR,
         COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT MTH_NBR, dispute_count
FROM disputes
ORDER BY MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment_code;

WITH txn_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
all_cust AS (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM all_cust ac
LEFT JOIN txn_2025 tx ON ac.CUST_K = tx.CUST_K
WHERE tx.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH auth_2025 AS (
  SELECT a.PMT_STS_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM auth_2025;

SELECT
  d.CSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
  COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K

WITH
  wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  ),
  atm_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  )
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM wire_customers w
JOIN atm_customers a ON w.CUST_K = a.CUST_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

WITH recent_interactions AS (
  SELECT
    ci.CUST_K,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ci.INTRC_TYP_CD1 = 'COMPLAINT') AS complaint_cnt,
    AVG(CAST(ci.STSFC_SCR_VAL1 AS NUMERIC)) AS avg_satisfaction,
    MAX(ci.CNTCT_STRTD_AT) AS last_contact
  FROM bank_dwh.F_CUST_INTRC ci
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON ci.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.DT_K >= (SELECT MAX(DT_K) - 90 FROM bank_dwh.D_DT) -- last quarter
  GROUP BY ci.CUST_K
)
SELECT
  c.CUST_K,
  c.BUS_ID,
  c.DSPLY_NM,
  ri.complaint_cnt,
  ri.avg_satisfaction,
  ri.last_contact
FROM recent_interactions ri
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON ri.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
ORDER BY ri.complaint_cnt DESC, ri.avg_satisfaction ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH d AS (
  SELECT DT_K, DT_YR
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE DT_YR = 2025
)
SELECT
  f.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;
